asked.item: Mix six images and one video in a single LinkedIn carousel
Posting to a LinkedIn company page through the API

verdict.reason: S59 says videos cannot be mixed into a carousel, and S57, S58, S56 and S50 cover the image carousel and company page details.

steps.text: No, videos cannot be mixed into a carousel.
For a carousel, pass 2-10 image URLs (JPG, PNG) in content.mediaUrls, and Blotato builds a LinkedIn Document carousel from them.
To post to a company page, add pageId in the target object, using the LinkedIn Company Page ID from subaccounts.
